contract.note: Local repeatable baseline; Telegram acknowledgement is not a read receipt and these percentiles are not a production SLO.

boundaries.provider_observation_ms: payment observed (fixture delay and any bounded history sweep included)
boundaries.pickup_to_first_credential_ack_ms: pickup to first credential-bearing Telegram acknowledgement
boundaries.receipt_completion_to_admin_notice_ms: receipt completion to admin notice acknowledgement
boundaries.e2e_observation_to_admin_notice_ms: payment observation to admin notice acknowledgement

pin_boundaries.pin_queue_wait_ms: pin job enqueue to pin worker pickup
pin_boundaries.pin_finished_after_receipt_completion_ms: positive means the pin finished after the receipt group completed
pin_boundaries.pin_finished_after_admin_ack_ms: positive means the pin finished after the admin paid notice acknowledgement

contract.pin_note: The credential pin is optional convenience work; its timestamps are reported separately and never gate receipt completion or the admin notice.
contract.percentile: nearest rank over available samples; p95 requires at least 20 known samples; unknown timestamps stay unknown; no p99
contract.cold_start: warm-up batches are reported separately and excluded from warmed percentiles
